en-US.longDescription:
This is the end-host client for ebbflow.
This is used to proxy SSH or TCP connections between ebbflow and your local server.
It typically runs as a daemon which is initiated during the install process, but can also be ran directly which suits containers.
en-US.name: ebbflow
